note: Locked canonical camera frames for the Art Match QA ratchet (Stage 5.5). Every bake is judged from THESE cameras only — never random gameplay angles. Rendered clean (no HUD/kart) and art-lit (aimed sun+shadows, tone mapping) by shoot-street.mjs --hero. Coords are game world XZ (metres); heading = degrees from north (−Z) clockwise; eye = camera height; pitch = up-tilt degrees. Scorecard = the visible requirements each frame must satisfy to read as its target; tick them by eye against target + render.
